# Bring PCL's GPU KinectFusion and people-detection modules to CUDA 12.8 (RTX 5090) `/workspace` contains three repositories (each its own git repo): | repo | what it is | |---|---| | `pcl` | The Point Cloud Library at upstream commit `c47198828`. Its GPU stack:
• `gpu/containers` and `gpu/utils`: device arrays, texture helpers, warp and block primitives
• `gpu/octree`, `gpu/features`, `gpu/surface`
• the applications `gpu/kinfu` (KinectFusion), `gpu/kinfu_large_scale` (KinectFusion with a moving cyclical volume) and `gpu/people` (random-forest body-part detection, including vendored NVIDIA NCV / NPP-staging primitives) | | `kinfu_replay` | A downstream tool that runs KinFu and KinFu large-scale on synthetic depth sequences with known ground truth. It reports poses, TSDF statistics, meshes, extracted clouds and timing, and can run several trackers concurrently (`--concurrent`). | | `people_eval` | A downstream tool that runs the people detector on an RGB-D frame and its variants (`people_eval`, with `--threads` for concurrent detectors), and exercises the NCV / NPP-staging primitives (`ncv_check`). | The lab's new machine has an **RTX 5090 (Blackwell, sm_120)**, which needs **CUDA 12.8** or later, and that is the only toolkit installed (`/usr/local/cuda`). On CUDA 12, PCL's CMake disables `gpu_kinfu`, `gpu_kinfu_large_scale` and `gpu_people` ("uses textures which was removed in CUDA 12"); see upstream issues #5571 and #5995. The code was written for pre-Volta GPUs. **Make these three modules, and everything they depend on, build and run correctly on CUDA 12.8 / sm_120.** The two tools must keep working unchanged. ## Requirements 1. **Builds on CUDA 12.8.** - `pcl` configures and builds with CUDA 12.8 for sm_120, with `gpu_kinfu`, `gpu_kinfu_large_scale` and `gpu_people` enabled by default. - No texture or surface *references* remain anywhere in the GPU modules. You may use texture objects or other memory paths. - All device code (SASS and PTX) must target sm_120: do not lower the architecture, rely on JIT of an older target, or vendor another CUDA toolkit. 2. **Same results as the original pre-CUDA-12 code.** The original was built with CUDA 11.8, run on this GPU through PTX JIT, and recorded: - People detector body-part labels must match **exactly**, run with `OMP_NUM_THREADS=1`. - The NCV / NPP-staging primitives exercised by `ncv_check` must produce **bit-identical** buffers. That covers integral images (also from unaligned sources), decimation, rectangle std-dev, separable filters, resize and frame interpolation, plus compaction and transpose. - KinFu and KinFu large-scale must track and reconstruct as well as the original, measured against ground truth. Their TSDF volumes, meshes and extracted clouds must agree with the original's to within floating-point noise. 3. **Correct on independent thread scheduling.** - The modernized kernels must not depend on implicit warp-synchronous execution. - `compute-sanitizer` must report nothing on the KinFu, KinFu large-scale, people and NCV workloads with `--tool racecheck`, `--tool synccheck` and `--tool memcheck`. 4. **Safe for concurrent use.** - Several `KinfuTracker`, `kinfuLS::KinfuTracker`, `MarchingCubes` and `PeopleDetector` instances may run at the same time from different host threads. - Every result must then be bitwise identical to running each alone. 5. **Much faster than the original.** The lab moved to this GPU to run these pipelines faster. Measured on the same GPU against the original running through PTX JIT, each may take at most this fraction of the original's time: - per-frame KinFu and KinFu large-scale processing (`KinfuTracker::operator()`): 0.70×; - marching cubes (`MarchingCubes::run`): 0.55×; - zero-crossing cloud extraction (`TsdfVolume::fetchCloud`): 0.75×; - the people detector (`PeopleDetector::process`, with `OMP_NUM_THREADS=1`): 0.50×. The result requirements above still hold for the faster code. 6. **The tools are graded from their original sources.** Your changes to `kinfu_replay` and `people_eval` are discarded. ## Grading The grader takes your diff of `/workspace/pcl` against its `base` tag and builds it from scratch with CUDA 12.8 (sm_120). It then builds the pristine `kinfu_replay` and `people_eval` against it and runs hidden tests that compare against results recorded with the original code. The tests cover: - KinFu and KinFu large-scale on several trajectories and noise levels; - the people detector on frame variants; - the NCV primitives; - concurrency; - workloads drawn at grading time; - compute-sanitizer race, sync and memory checks; - the timing above (as measured by the tools). All of it must pass. ## Working rules - Every command runs in a fresh shell inside the task sandbox, starting in /workspace: `cd` and exported variables do not persist (prefix commands, or write them to a file and `source` it). - A command times out after 1800 s. Keep builds and benchmark runs bounded (build in the background and poll a log file if needed; PCL's GPU modules take several minutes to build with `-j 16`). - The sandbox has no network access and nobody will answer questions. Work until the task is completely done, verifying your work yourself on the GPU. - Edit files with heredocs (`cat <<'EOF' > file`), `sed -i`, or small python scripts. - When you are completely finished, submit by running exactly `echo COMPLETE_TASK_AND_SUBMIT_FINAL_OUTPUT` on its own. After that you cannot continue. The state of /workspace at that point is graded as-is.     template<bool testFG> __device__ __forceinline__ Label 
    evaluateTree(int u, int v, float f, int treeHeight, int numNodes, const Node* nodes, const Label* leaves)
    {
      int    depth = tex2D(depthTex, u, v);

      float  scale = f / depth;

      // go down the tree
      int nid = 0;
      for(int nodeDepth = 0; nodeDepth < treeHeight; ++nodeDepth)
      {
        const Node node = nodes[nid];

        const AttribLocation& loc = node.loc;
        int d1 = tex2D (depthTex, u + loc.du1 * scale, v + loc.dv1 * scale);
        int d2 = tex2D (depthTex, u + loc.du2 * scale, v + loc.dv2 * scale);

        if (testFG)
        {
          if( d1 - depth > constFGThresh ) 
            d1 = std::numeric_limits<short>::max();

          if( d2 - depth > constFGThresh ) 
            d2 = std::numeric_limits<short>::max();
        }

        int delta = d1-d2;
        bool test = delta > (int)node.thresh;
        if( test ) nid = nid*2+2;
        else       nid = nid*2+1;
      }
      return leaves[nid-numNodes];
    }

namespace pcl
{
  namespace device
  {   
    __device__ __forceinline__ int findRoot(const PtrStepSz<int>& comps, int label)
    {                       
        for(;;)
        {
          int y = label / comps.cols;
          int x = label - y * comps.cols;

          int parent = comps.ptr(y)[x];

          if (label == parent)
              break;

          label = parent;          
        }
        return label;
    }

    texture<unsigned char, 2, cudaReadModeElementType> edgesTex;
    
    struct TilesMerge
    {           
      int tileSizeX;
      int tileSizeY;
      int tilesNumX;
      int tilesNumY;

      mutable PtrStepSz<int> comps;

      __device__ __forceinline__ void 
      unionF(int l1, int l2, bool& changed) const
      {
        int r1 = findRoot(comps, l1);
        int r2 = findRoot(comps, l2);
        
        if (r1 != r2)
        {          
          int mi = min(r1, r2);
          int ma = max(r1, r2);

          int y = ma / comps.cols;
          int x = ma - y * comps.cols;
          atomicMin(&comps.ptr(y)[x], mi);
          changed = true;
        }        
      } 
      
      __device__ __forceinline__ void
      operator()() const
      {
        int tid = Block::flattenedThreadId();
        int stride = Block::stride();
                
        int xbeg = blockIdx.x * tilesNumX * tileSizeX;
        int xend = xbeg + tilesNumX * tileSizeX;

        int ybeg = blockIdx.y * tilesNumY * tileSizeY;
        int yend = ybeg + tilesNumY * tileSizeY;

        int tasksH = (tilesNumY - 1) * (xend - xbeg);
        int tasksV = (tilesNumX - 1) * (yend - ybeg);

        int total = tasksH + tasksV;
        
        bool changed;
        do
        {           
          changed = false;

          for( int task_index = tid; task_index < total; task_index += stride)
            if (task_index < tasksH)
            {
              int indexH = task_index;

              int row = indexH / (xend - xbeg);
              int col = indexH - row * (xend - xbeg);

              int y = ybeg + (row + 1) * tileSizeY;
              int x = xbeg + col;

              int e = tex2D(edgesTex, x, y);
              if (e & Edges::UP)
              {
                int lc = comps.ptr(y  )[x];
                int lu = comps.ptr(y-1)[x];
                unionF(lc, lu, changed);
              }
            }
            else
            {
              int indexV = task_index - tasksH;

              int col = indexV / (yend - ybeg);
              int row = indexV - col * (yend - ybeg);

              int x = xbeg + (col + 1) * tileSizeX;
              int y = ybeg + row;
              
              int e = tex2D(edgesTex, x, y);
              if (e & Edges::LEFT)
              {
                int lc = comps.ptr(y)[x  ];
                int ll = comps.ptr(y)[x-1];
                unionF(lc, ll, changed);
              }                                                                                 
            }                   
        }
        while(__syncthreads_or(changed));
      }

    };

    __global__ void mergeKernel(const TilesMerge tm) { tm(); }        
  }
}

// Runs every variant of the frame through one detector; writes OUT/<variant>.labels and OUT/result.json.
int run_detector(const Cloud& base, const std::string& trees, const std::string& out, const std::vector<std::string>& vars, int repeat) {
  std::vector<std::string> names = {trees + "/tree_20_1.txt", trees + "/tree_20_2.txt", trees + "/tree_20_3.txt"};
  pcl::gpu::people::RDFBodyPartsDetector::Ptr rdf(new pcl::gpu::people::RDFBodyPartsDetector(names));
  pcl::gpu::people::PeopleDetector det;
  det.rdf_detector_ = rdf;
  std::ofstream js(out + "/result.json");
  js << "{";
  for (size_t vi = 0; vi < vars.size(); ++vi) {
    Cloud::Ptr c = variant(base, vars[vi]);
    int ret = -1;
    std::vector<double> ms;
    for (int r = 0; r < repeat; ++r) {
      cudaDeviceSynchronize();
      auto t0 = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
      ret = det.process(c);
      cudaDeviceSynchronize();
      ms.push_back(std::chrono::duration<double, std::milli>(std::chrono::steady_clock::now() - t0).count());
    }
    std::sort(ms.begin(), ms.end());
    std::vector<unsigned char> labels;
    int cols;
    rdf->getLabels().download(labels, cols);
    std::ofstream lf(out + "/" + vars[vi] + ".labels", std::ios::binary);
    lf.write(reinterpret_cast<const char*>(labels.data()), labels.size());
    std::map<int, long> hist;
    for (auto l : labels) hist[l]++;
    js << (vi ? ", " : "") << "\"" << vars[vi] << "\": {\"return\": " << ret << ", \"ms_median\": " << ms[ms.size() / 2]
       << ", \"histogram\": {";
    bool first = true;
    for (auto& kv : hist) {
      js << (first ? "" : ", ") << "\"" << kv.first << "\": " << kv.second;
      first = false;
    }
    js << "}}";
  }
  js << "}\n";
  return 0;
}

int main(int argc, char** argv) try {
  std::string pcd, trees, out = ".", which = "all";
  int repeat = 1, threads = 0;
  for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {
    std::string k = argv[i];
    if (i + 1 >= argc) throw std::runtime_error("missing value for " + k);
    std::string v = argv[++i];
    if (k == "--pcd") pcd = v;
    else if (k == "--trees") trees = v;
    else if (k == "--out") out = v;
    else if (k == "--variants") which = v;
    else if (k == "--repeat") repeat = std::stoi(v);
    else if (k == "--threads") threads = std::stoi(v);
    else throw std::runtime_error("unknown argument " + k);
  }
  Cloud base;
  if (pcl::io::loadPCDFile(pcd, base) != 0 || base.width != 640 || base.height != 480)
    throw std::runtime_error("cannot read an organized 640x480 cloud from " + pcd);
  std::vector<std::string> vars = which == "all" ? std::vector<std::string>{"base", "mirror", "farther", "noise", "holes"}
                                                 : split(which);
  if (threads <= 0) return run_detector(base, trees, out, vars, repeat);
  // --threads K: K independent detectors at the same time, each on the variants in a
  // different order; thread t writes to OUT/thread<t>/
  std::vector<std::thread> th;
  std::vector<int> rc(threads, 1);
  for (int t = 0; t < threads; ++t) {
    std::vector<std::string> mine = vars;
    std::rotate(mine.begin(), mine.begin() + (t % mine.size()), mine.end());
    std::string dir = out + "/thread" + std::to_string(t);
    std::filesystem::create_directories(dir);
    th.emplace_back([&, t, mine, dir] {
      try { rc[t] = run_detector(base, trees, dir, mine, repeat); }
      catch (const std::exception& e) { std::cerr << "thread " << t << ": " << e.what() << std::endl; rc[t] = 1; }
    });
  }
  for (auto& x : th) x.join();
  for (int r : rc)
    if (r) return 1;
  return 0;
} catch (const std::exception& e) {
  std::cerr << "people_eval: " << e.what() << std::endl;
  return 1;
}

// exact, order-independent checksum of a point set (sum of the coordinates' bit patterns)
template <class Point>
std::uint64_t pointChecksum(const std::vector<Point>& pts) {
  std::uint64_t s = 0;
  for (const auto& p : pts) {
    std::uint32_t b[3];
    std::memcpy(&b[0], &p.x, 4);
    std::memcpy(&b[1], &p.y, 4);
    std::memcpy(&b[2], &p.z, 4);
    s += b[0] + 3ull * b[1] + 7ull * b[2];
  }

  // slices through the volume centre: x = res/2 (y,z), y = res/2 (x,z), z = res/2 (x,y); layout x fastest, then y, then z
  auto at = [&](int x, int y, int z) {
    int v = vox[((size_t)z * res + y) * res + x];
    short w = (short)((unsigned)v >> 16);
    return w ? (short)(v & 0xffff) / 32767.f : 2.f;
  };
  int h = res / 2;
  for (int a = 0; a < res; ++a)
    for (int b = 0; b < res; ++b) {
      slices[(size_t)a * res + b] = at(h, a, b);
      slices[(size_t)res * res + (size_t)a * res + b] = at(a, h, b);
      slices[2 * (size_t)res * res + (size_t)a * res + b] = at(a, b, h);
    }
  return s;
}

template <class Pixel>
std::string saveView(const std::string& path, const pcl::gpu::DeviceArray2D<Pixel>& view) {
  std::vector<Pixel> h;
  int cols;
  view.download(h, cols);
  const int rows = cols ? (int)(h.size() / cols) : 0;
  std::ofstream f(path, std::ios::binary);
  f.write(reinterpret_cast<const char*>(&rows), 4);
  f.write(reinterpret_cast<const char*>(&cols), 4);
  double sum[3] = {0, 0, 0};
  for (const auto& p : h) {
    const unsigned char c[3] = {p.r, p.g, p.b};
    f.write(reinterpret_cast<const char*>(c), 3);
    sum[0] += c[0]; sum[1] += c[1]; sum[2] += c[2];
  }
  const double k = h.empty() ? 0 : 1.0 / h.size();
  return "{\"rows\": " + std::to_string(rows) + ", \"cols\": " + std::to_string(cols) + ", \"mean\": [" + num(sum[0] * k) + "," +
         num(sum[1] * k) + "," + num(sum[2] * k) + "]}";
}

std::string colorStats(const Eigen::Affine3f& T, const std::vector<pcl::PointXYZ>& pts, const std::vector<pcl::RGB>& cols, bool gt) {
  double err = 0, mean[3] = {0, 0, 0};
  const size_t n = std::min(pts.size(), cols.size());
  for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
    mean[0] += cols[i].r; mean[1] += cols[i].g; mean[2] += cols[i].b;
    if (gt) {
      std::uint8_t ref[3];
      sceneColor(T * Eigen::Vector3f(pts[i].x, pts[i].y, pts[i].z), ref);
      err += (std::abs((int)cols[i].r - ref[0]) + std::abs((int)cols[i].g - ref[1]) + std::abs((int)cols[i].b - ref[2])) / 3.0;
    }
  }
  const double k = n ? 1.0 / n : 0;
  std::string s = "{\"points\": " + std::to_string(n) + ", \"mean\": [" + num(mean[0] * k) + "," + num(mean[1] * k) + "," + num(mean[2] * k) + "]";
  if (gt) s += ", \"abs_err_mean\": " + num(err * k);
  return s + "}";
}

NCV_CT_ASSERT(K_WARP_SIZE == 32); //this is required for the manual unroll of the loop in warpScanInclusive


//Almost the same as naive scan1Inclusive, but doesn't need __syncthreads()
//assuming size <= WARP_SIZE and size is power of 2
template <class T>
inline __device__ T warpScanInclusive(T idata, volatile T *s_Data)
{
    Ncv32u pos = 2 * threadIdx.x - (threadIdx.x & (K_WARP_SIZE - 1));
    s_Data[pos] = 0;
    pos += K_WARP_SIZE;
    s_Data[pos] = idata;

    //for(Ncv32u offset = 1; offset < K_WARP_SIZE; offset <<= 1)
    //{
    //    s_Data[pos] += s_Data[pos - offset];
    //}

    s_Data[pos] += s_Data[pos - 1];
    s_Data[pos] += s_Data[pos - 2];
    s_Data[pos] += s_Data[pos - 4];
    s_Data[pos] += s_Data[pos - 8];
    s_Data[pos] += s_Data[pos - 16];

    return s_Data[pos];
}


template <class T>
inline __device__ T warpScanExclusive(T idata, volatile T *s_Data)
{
    return warpScanInclusive(idata, s_Data) - idata;
}


template <class T, Ncv32u tiNumScanThreads>
inline __device__ T blockScanInclusive(T idata, volatile T *s_Data)
{
    if (tiNumScanThreads > K_WARP_SIZE)
    {
        //Bottom-level inclusive warp scan
        T warpResult = warpScanInclusive(idata, s_Data);

        //Save top elements of each warp for exclusive warp scan
        //sync to wait for warp scans to complete (because s_Data is being overwritten)
        __syncthreads();
        if( (threadIdx.x & (K_WARP_SIZE - 1)) == (K_WARP_SIZE - 1) )
        {
            s_Data[threadIdx.x >> K_LOG2_WARP_SIZE] = warpResult;
        }

        //wait for warp scans to complete
        __syncthreads();

        if( threadIdx.x < (tiNumScanThreads / K_WARP_SIZE) )
        {
            //grab top warp elements
            T val = s_Data[threadIdx.x];
            //calculate exclusive scan and write back to shared memory
            s_Data[threadIdx.x] = warpScanExclusive(val, s_Data);
        }

        //return updated warp scans with exclusive scan results
        __syncthreads();
        return warpResult + s_Data[threadIdx.x >> K_LOG2_WARP_SIZE];
    }
    else
    {
        return warpScanInclusive(idata, s_Data);
    }
}

			}

				}
				__syncthreads();				
				return buffer[0];
			}

			template <typename T, class BinOp>
			static __device__ __forceinline__ void reduce_n(T* data, unsigned int n, BinOp op)
			{
				int ftid = flattenedThreadId();
				int sft = stride();

				if (sft < n)
				{
					for (unsigned int i = sft + ftid; i < n; i += sft)
						data[ftid] = op(data[ftid], data[i]);

					__syncthreads();

				while (n > 1)

					unsigned int half = n/2;

					if (ftid < half)
						data[ftid] = op(data[ftid], data[n - ftid - 1]);

					__syncthreads();

					n = n - half;

__forceinline__ __device__ float getValueMirrorRow(const int rowOffset,
                                                   int i,

{
    if (i < 0) i = 1 - i;

__forceinline__ __device__ float getValueMirrorColumn(const int offset,
                                                      const int rowStep,
                                                      int j,
                                                      int h)
{
    if (j < 0) j = 1 - j;
    if (j >= h) j = h + h - j - 1;
    return tex1Dfetch (texSrc, offset + j * rowStep);
}

// bicubic interpolation
__forceinline__
__device__ float bicubicCoeff(float x_)
{
    float x = std::abs(x_);
    if (x <= 1.0f)
    {
        return x * x * (1.5f * x - 2.5f) + 1.0f;
    }
    else if (x < 2.0f)
    {
        return x * (x * (-0.5f * x + 2.5f) - 4.0f) + 2.0f;
    }
    else
    {
        return 0.0f;
    }
}

    scan_warp ( volatile T *ptr, const unsigned int idx = threadIdx.x )
    {
      const unsigned int lane = idx & 31;       // index of thread in warp (0..31) 

      if (lane >=  1) ptr[idx] = ptr[idx -  1] + ptr[idx];
      if (lane >=  2) ptr[idx] = ptr[idx -  2] + ptr[idx];
      if (lane >=  4) ptr[idx] = ptr[idx -  4] + ptr[idx];
      if (lane >=  8) ptr[idx] = ptr[idx -  8] + ptr[idx];
      if (lane >= 16) ptr[idx] = ptr[idx - 16] + ptr[idx];

      if (Kind == inclusive)

#ifndef PCL_GPU_UTILS_TEXTURE_BINDER_HPP_
#define PCL_GPU_UTILS_TEXTURE_BINDER_HPP_

#include <pcl/gpu/containers/device_array.h>
#include <pcl/gpu/utils/safe_call.hpp>

namespace pcl {
namespace gpu {
class TextureBinder {
public:
  template <class T, enum cudaTextureReadMode readMode>
  TextureBinder(const DeviceArray2D<T>& arr, const struct texture<T, 2, readMode>& tex)
  : texref(&tex)
  {
    cudaChannelFormatDesc desc = cudaCreateChannelDesc<T>();
    cudaSafeCall(
        cudaBindTexture2D(0, tex, arr.ptr(), desc, arr.cols(), arr.rows(), arr.step()));
  }

  template <class T, enum cudaTextureReadMode readMode>
  TextureBinder(const DeviceArray<T>& arr, const struct texture<T, 1, readMode>& tex)
  : texref(&tex)
  {
    cudaChannelFormatDesc desc = cudaCreateChannelDesc<T>();
    cudaSafeCall(cudaBindTexture(0, tex, arr.ptr(), desc, arr.sizeBytes()));
  }

  template <class T, enum cudaTextureReadMode readMode>
  TextureBinder(const PtrStepSz<T>& arr, const struct texture<T, 2, readMode>& tex)
  : texref(&tex)
  {
    cudaChannelFormatDesc desc = cudaCreateChannelDesc<T>();
    cudaSafeCall(
        cudaBindTexture2D(0, tex, arr.data, desc, arr.cols, arr.rows, arr.step));
  }

  template <class T, enum cudaTextureReadMode readMode>
  TextureBinder(const PtrSz<T>& arr, const struct texture<T, 1, readMode>& tex)
  : texref(&tex)
  {
    cudaChannelFormatDesc desc = cudaCreateChannelDesc<T>();
    cudaSafeCall(cudaBindTexture(0, tex, arr.data, desc, arr.size * arr.elemSize()));
  }

  ~TextureBinder() { cudaSafeCall(cudaUnbindTexture(texref)); }

private:
  const struct textureReference* texref;
};
} // namespace gpu

namespace device {
using pcl::gpu::TextureBinder;
}
} // namespace pcl

#endif /* PCL_GPU_UTILS_TEXTURE_BINDER_HPP_*/

    enum ScanKind { exclusive, inclusive };

    template<ScanKind Kind, class T>
    __device__ __forceinline__ T
    scan_warp ( volatile T *ptr, const unsigned int idx = threadIdx.x )
    {
      const unsigned lane = idx & 31;
      const unsigned mask = __activemask();
      T value = ptr[idx];
      #pragma unroll
      for (int offset = 1; offset < 32; offset <<= 1)
      {
        T other = __shfl_up_sync(mask, value, offset);
        if (lane >= static_cast<unsigned>(offset)) value += other;
      }
      if (Kind == inclusive) return value;
      T previous = __shfl_up_sync(mask, value, 1);
      return lane ? previous : T(0);
      }
  }
}

//Almost the same as naive scan1Inclusive, but doesn't need __syncthreads()
//assuming size <= WARP_SIZE and size is power of 2
__device__ Ncv32u warpScanInclusive(Ncv32u idata, volatile Ncv32u *s_Data)
{
    Ncv32u pos = 2 * threadIdx.x - (threadIdx.x & (K_WARP_SIZE - 1));
    s_Data[pos] = 0;
    pos += K_WARP_SIZE;
    s_Data[pos] = idata;

    s_Data[pos] += s_Data[pos - 1];
    s_Data[pos] += s_Data[pos - 2];
    s_Data[pos] += s_Data[pos - 4];
    s_Data[pos] += s_Data[pos - 8];
    s_Data[pos] += s_Data[pos - 16];

    return s_Data[pos];
}

__device__ __forceinline__ Ncv32u warpScanExclusive(Ncv32u idata, volatile Ncv32u *s_Data)
{
    return warpScanInclusive(idata, s_Data) - idata;
}

template <Ncv32u tiNumScanThreads>
__device__ Ncv32u scan1Inclusive(Ncv32u idata, volatile Ncv32u *s_Data)
{
    if (tiNumScanThreads > K_WARP_SIZE)
    {
        //Bottom-level inclusive warp scan
        Ncv32u warpResult = warpScanInclusive(idata, s_Data);

        //Save top elements of each warp for exclusive warp scan
        //sync to wait for warp scans to complete (because s_Data is being overwritten)
        __syncthreads();
        if( (threadIdx.x & (K_WARP_SIZE - 1)) == (K_WARP_SIZE - 1) )
        {
            s_Data[threadIdx.x >> K_LOG2_WARP_SIZE] = warpResult;
        }

        //wait for warp scans to complete
        __syncthreads();

        if( threadIdx.x < (tiNumScanThreads / K_WARP_SIZE) )
        {
            //grab top warp elements
            Ncv32u val = s_Data[threadIdx.x];
            //calculate exclusive scan and write back to shared memory
            s_Data[threadIdx.x] = warpScanExclusive(val, s_Data);
        }

        //return updated warp scans with exclusive scan results
        __syncthreads();
        return warpResult + s_Data[threadIdx.x >> K_LOG2_WARP_SIZE];
    }
    else
    {
        return warpScanInclusive(idata, s_Data);
    }
}
